source_scope: EIA daily NYH/USGC conventional gasoline spot prices plus dated AAA state regular-price snapshots
retail_basis: AAA state average regular gasoline, not MUSA pump prices; no regional gallon-weight equivalence claimed
availability: First capture timestamp is conservative available_at for snapshots; historical EIA download is current-vintage research, not historical PIT evidence
joins: Exact observed-date matches only; do not interpolate or forward-fill weekly retail prices
missing_history: BLOCKED_DAILY_RETAIL_HISTORY when no genuine archived daily retail history exists
features: spread change on consecutive calendar dates
positive and negative spread-change totals separately
within-week wholesale high-low range as diagnostic only
automated_aaa: Disabled unless an explicit permission artifact is supplied; robots allowances alone are not a data license
daily_shadow_scoring: Not authorized without a supported historical paired dataset and a separately frozen estimator
